correctness.rationale: Unitary DFT reduction independently yields 2-by-2 fiber Gram trace 2+t²(1-2u) and determinant t²(1-4u sin²πalpha). The zero residue forces the unique optimal t=√2 and condition 1+√2; a characteristic polynomial comparison proves the complete sharp shift plateau, the frequency-flat boundary and max/min extremizers. Positivity of the Gram determinant gives exactly one even-grid half-shift null; odd-grid half-shift asymptotics follow from the quadratic formula. The included independent 1791 finite checks agree.

value.rationale: Hermite trigonometric reconstruction from collocated or displaced derivative sensors is a natural sampling-design question. The result is a complete all-grid-size exact optimal phase set with a nontrivial tolerance interval, a flat lower singular edge at its boundary, and an exact odd-even singularity distinction. It quantifies noise robustness of a precise physical data-acquisition geometry and is not a mere coefficient renaming or one-off computational table.
